articles.summary: LONDON, May 7, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ECARX Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: ECX) ("ECARX" or the "Company"), a global mobility tech provider, today announced that it will report its financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026, before the U.S. market opens on Tuesday, May 19, 2026.
articles.title: ECARX Holdings to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on May 19, 2026

articles.summary: LONDON and ANN ARBOR, Mich., May 19, 2026 -- ECARX Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq:ECX) ("ECARX"), a leading global automotive intelligence company, today announced a strategic framework agreement with May Mobility Inc., a leading U.S.-based autonomous vehicle (AV) technology company, to bring ECARX's intelligent driving capacity to May Mobility's future autonomous fleet for scaling ride-hail deployment. The partnership has identified a third-party vehicle platform for initial targeted deployment starting next year, with commercialization scale-up in 2028.
articles.title: ECARX and May Mobility to Scale Autonomous Ride-Hail Fleet

articles.summary: LONDON, May 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ECARX Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: ECX) ("ECARX" or the "Company"), a leading global automotive intelligence company, today announced unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.
articles.title: ECARX Announces First Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

articles.summary: LONDON, May 29, 2026 -- ECARX Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: ECX) and TPK Holding Co., Ltd. (TWSE: TPK) (TPK) have signed a binding memorandum of business cooperation on the joint development of LiDAR technologies for global markets, marking ECARX's formal entry into the LiDAR sector.
articles.title: ECARX and TPK to Co-Develop ORCA LiDAR Platform, an all-new LiDAR platform for global markets
